countryData.description: The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the Federative Republic of Brazil. The partnership focuses on government accelerators, capacity building, competitiveness, services, programming, economy, and investment.

The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Republic of Montenegro. 

This partnership aims to strengthen cooperation across a range of vital areas, including digital transformation, artificial intelligence, sustainable development, business incubators, digital economy, tourism, and capacity building.

In 2024, The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Indonesia.
The partnership aims to exchange expertise and successful experiences across various fields through the adoption of best government practices.

In 2024, The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the the Republic of Cuba during the World Government Summit, with the aim of strengthening cooperation in the areas of government accelerators, capacity building, and government performance.

The UAE and the government of Dominican Republic launched a government partnership aiming at strengthening cooperation in the field of government modernization.
The agreement focuses on experience exchange and capacity building to achieve excellence in government performance and innovation in service delivery.

In February 2018, within the sixth edition of the World Governments Summit, and in the presence of His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, UAE Vice President, Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, a strategic partnership agreement was signed in government modernization between the United Arab Emirates and the Arab Republic of Egypt.

The strategic partnership aims to exchange governmental experiences between the United Arab Emirates and the Arab Republic of Egypt.

His Highness Sheikh Maktoum bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Deputy Ruler of Dubai, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Finance, met with Ana Brnabić, Prime Minister of Serbia, in Dubai.
His Highness discussed with the Serbian Prime Minister ways to strengthen bilateral relationships in various fields of mutual interest. His Highness also witnessed the signing of an agreement between the UAE and Serbia to promote knowledge exchange and enhance capacity development and implementation of best practices in each other’s government sectors.

The agreement between UAE and Serbia follows a series of meetings, summits and visits that fostered knowledge exchange on enhancement of government performance and efficiency with a focus on 13 key pillars. The agreement signed on 12 May 2022 creates a framework for sharing expertise in the areas of Smart Gov. Services, Digital economy, Science and Innovation, Government Capacity-Building, Business Incubators, Creative Industries and Tourism, Education, Coding, AI and Metaverse, Media, Competitiveness, Expo 2020 and Gov. Accelerator.

In June 2018, during the visit of a delegation from the United Arab Emirates, headed by His Excellency Mohammed Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs of the United Arab Emirates, to Jordan, a Memorandum of Understanding was signed between the two governments in the strategic partnership in developing government performance as well as forming a joint technical committee of the memorandum of understanding and ensuring its effective implementation, and to form working groups and experts, in support of various initiatives and joint projects.

The agreement between the two countries included various strategic initiatives and areas of cooperation that would enhance the partnership between the two governments, and contribute to modernizing government performance in the Hashemite Kingdom of Jordan, thus contributing to the development of government performance and upgrading the governmental work system in the public sector.

The areas of cooperation include developing government services, smart services, government performance, innovation and excellence, building and developing leaders and capabilities of government officials and enhancing competencies, as well as transferring knowledge, and benefiting from mutual experiences in common areas of government work.

On March 26, 2019, His Excellency Shavkat Mirziyoyev, President of the Republic of Uzbekistan held a fruitful meeting with His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum and His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Al Nahyan. Two weeks later, on April 10, UAE delegation visited the Uzbek capital of Tashkent in The visit culminated in the signing of a partnership agreement to modernize government work between the two countries on April 11. And in May 5 UAE welcomed high-level Uzbek delegation to translate this agreement into reality through launching many joint initiatives.

The Strategic Partnership in Government Experience Exchange aims to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in various fields, including smart government services, strategy and the national agenda, government accelerators, and many others.

The UAE Government signed strategic partnerships with the government of the Republic of Maldives, the signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, during the World Government Summit 2022 (WGS2022), signed the partnership agreement with Faisal Naseem, Vice President of the Republic of Maldives.

The agreement benefits governments from the experience of the UAE in development and modernization, human capabilities and adopting best practices in government work. The UAE government will also work together with each government in building government capacities, services, performance and excellence, civil service, competitiveness and statistics, accelerators, business incubators, programming, media, coding, and government innovation.

The United Arab Emirates & Republic of Costa Rica bilateral agreement aims to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in the areas of capacity building through holding ministerial sessions, virtual workshops, and field visits. Through the supervision of a joint committee.

The MOU was signed in Feb 2019 where training, workshops, and programs were launched in various areas of cooperation.

Lieutenant General His Highness Sheikh Saif bin Zayed Al Nahyan,Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Interior, and Édouard Ngirente, Prime Minister of the Republic of Rwanda, witnessed the launch of a partnership between the governments of the United Arab Emirates and the Republic of Rwanda in the field of government work modernization, as part of the government experience exchange program partnerships.

The cooperation focuses on empowering government agencies and human capabilities in Rwanda and enhancing the exchange of government expertise and experiences between the two sides.

His Highness Sheikh Mohammad Bin Zayed President of the United Arab Emirates and ruler of Abu Dhabi, and Macky Sall President of Senegal, witnessed the signing of agreements and Memorandums of Understanding in February 2020 between the two countries.  The agreement aims to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in the areas of government services, government performance, government excellence, and digital transformation. Through the supervision of a joint committee.

The MoU between the UAE and the Government of Senegal related to government modernization and development was signed by Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, and Amadou Ba Minister of Foreign Affairs of Senegal.

The UAE Government has signed a strategic partnership with the government of Seychelles.

The signing aims to accelerate government modernisation efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

His Excellency Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, during the World Government Summit 2022 (WGS2022), signed the partnership agreement with Her Excellency Devika Vidot, Minister of Investment, Entrepreneurship & Industry, in the Republic of Seychelles.

The agreement will see the government benefit from the experience of the UAE in development and modernization, human capabilities and adopting best practices in government work. The MoU will focus on 9 key pillars, in the areas of Capacity Building, Government Accelerator, Government Services, Urban planning, Civil services, Government performance, Government competitiveness and finical Sector

The Memorandum of understanding between the United Arab Emirates and the Hellenic Republic was signed during the UAE-Greece Strategic Cooperation Forum in July 2020.  

The United Arab Emirates and the Hellenic Republic aim to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in the fields of artificial intelligence, government performance, and government accelerators, through the supervision of a joint committee.

The United Arab Emirates and the Republic of Sudan launched a strategic partnership in government modernization in 2021. As part of their efforts to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in various fields including.

The signing of the Strategic partnership came as part of an official visit of a delegation from the UAE government to the Republic of Sudan, headed by Her Excellency Ohoud bint Khalfan Al Roumi, Minister of State for Government Development and the Future to enhance the march of distinguished bilateral relations, and opportunities to expand the circle of cooperation and exchange of knowledge and expertise in the areas of government work, and witnessed the signing of the strategic partnership agreement in modernization. The government, through which the two sides will work to share experiences and knowledge to develop government work in various areas of cooperation.

The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Guyana, the signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Chairman of the World Government Summit Organization, during the World Government Summit 2022 (WGS2022), signed the partnership agreement with Deodat Indar, Minister within the Ministry of Public Works, Guyana.

The agreement will see the governments benefit from the experience of the UAE in development and modernization, human capabilities and adopting best practices in government work. The UAE government will also work together with each government in building government capacities, services, performance and excellence, civil service, competitiveness and statistics, accelerators, business incubators, programming, media, coding, and government innovation.

The government of the United Arab Emirates and the government of the Republic of Iraq launched a strategic partnership in government modernization and development in 2021, based on enhancing the exchange of knowledge, expertise and successful experiences between the two countries.

The strategic partnership agreement includes 11 workstreams, including government performance, government excellence, government services, government capacity building, civil service, competitiveness and statistics, government accelerators, business incubators, media, government innovation, and programming.

The signing of a memorandum of cooperation in government modernization between the government of the UAE and the government of the Kyrgyz Republic, to strengthen cooperation and exchange expertise and experiences, to improve performance and productivity, and achieve sustainable development in the government work system in Kyrgyzstan.

The memorandum was signed by His Excellency Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, and Akilbek Jabarov, Prime Minister of the Kyrgyz Republic, in the presence of His Highness Sheikh Maktoum bin Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.

The United Arab Emirates & Republic of Colombia bilateral agreement was signed in Feb 2019. The partnership between the two governments aims to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in the areas of capacity building in the leadership and services. Supervised by a joint committee from both countries.

The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Madagascar.

The signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Chairman of the World Government Summit Organisation, during the World Government Summit 2024 (WGS2024), signed the partnership agreement with H.E. Rasata Rafaravavitafika, the Minister of Foreign Affairs in the Government of Madagascar. 

The agreement will see the government benefit from the experience of the UAE in development and modernization, human capabilities and adopting best practices in government work. The MoU will focus on 7 key pillars, in the areas of Coding, Capacity Building, Government Excellence, Government Services, Digitalization and Digital Transformation in Gov Services, Government Accelerators, and Artificial Intelligence

The United Arab Emirates & Kingdom of Spain launched a strategic partnership which was signed in February 2022. in the presence of His Highness Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates and Ruler of Dubai and His Excellency Pedro Sánchez, The Prime Minister of Kingdom of Spain. 

The partnership between the two governments aims to enhance cooperation and exchange experiences and knowledge in the areas of Management, Decision Making, Transparency, Women Empowerment, and Accountability Mechanisms. Supervised by a joint committee from both countries.

The UAE Government has signed a bilateral cooperation with the government of Barbados.

The signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Chairman of the World Government Summit Organisation, during the World Government Summit 2022 (WGS2022), signed the partnership agreement with Mia Mottley, Prime Minister of Barbados.

The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Mongolia.

The signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Chairman of the World Government Summit Organisation, during the World Government Summit 2024 (WGS2024), signed the partnership agreement with H.E. Uchral Nyam Osor, Mongolia's Minister of Digital Development and Communications.

The agreement will see the government benefit from the experience of the UAE in development and modernization, human capabilities and adopting best practices in government work. The MoU will focus on 5 key pillars, in the areas of Sustainable Development Goals, Government Performance, Government Services, Digitalization of Public Services, and Capacity Building.

His Highness Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum, UAE Vice President, Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai and His Excellency Faustin-Archange Touadéra, President of the Central African Republic witnessed the signing of a bilateral agreement focused on establishing collaboration to share expertise on government excellence.

The agreement was signed by His Excellency Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and His Excellency Obed Namsio, Minister of State and Director of the Cabinet of the President of the Central African Republic.

His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, met with Mario Abdo Benítez, President of Paraguay, on the sidelines of the World Government Summit, and discussed bilateral ties between the two countries and ways to further boost cooperation in the next phase in the fields of economy, investment and trade to support their sustainable development goals. The meeting also highlighted the UAE and Paraguay’s shared desire to explore new partnership opportunities that will further strengthen bridges of cooperation, especially in the field of government development.

His Highness and Mario Abdo Benítez witnessed the signing of a cooperation agreement that seeks to drive government modernization. The agreement aims to promote Paraguay’s government capabilities and empower its cadres across various government fields, drawing from the UAE's successful experience in government development.

The agreement focuses on exchanging knowledge, experiences, and best practices in government work, building capabilities of human cadres, boosting performance and evaluation systems, supporting various government development and innovation efforts, leading government excellence, finding effective proactive solutions to challenges, and developing various economic, technological, environmental, and social fields to enable future governments and improve the quality of life across communities.

Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the UAE and Ruler of Dubai, and Irakli Garibashvili Prime Minister of Georgia, witnessed the signing of an agreement between the two countries focused on establishing collaboration to share expertise in the field of government modernization as part of the Government Experience Exchange Programme. The agreement seeks to strengthen the capabilities of the government in Georgia and provide the latest tools to develop the skills of government employees.

His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, met with Edi Rama, Prime Minister of Albania, on the sidelines of the World Government Summit (WGS) 2023.

His Highness and the Prime Minister of Albania discussed bilateral ties between the two countries and ways to further strengthen cooperation in various fields. The meeting also highlighted the UAE and Albania’s shared desire to boost the exchange of knowledge and expertise in the field of government. Further, Sheikh Mohammed and Edi Rama witnessed the signing of the bilateral agreement focused on establishing collaboration to share expertise on government excellence as part of the Government Experience Exchange Programme (GEEP).

the Republic of Malta joined the Government Experience Exchange Program to accelerate modernization and development in various areas of government work.
Under this agreement, six areas of cooperation have been established, through which the Republic of Malta and the United Arab Emirates collaborate to advance digital technology, health and quality of life, sustainable resource utilization, smart manufacturing, programming, and capacity building.

The United Arab Emirates Government signed strategic partnerships with the governments of the Iraqi Kurdistan Regional Government. The signing aims to accelerate government modernization efforts and foster a culture of innovation.

Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, during the World Government Summit 2022, signed the partnership agreement with Masrour Barzani, President of the Kurdistan Regional Government of Iraq.

The Republic of Kazakhstan joined the Government Experience Exchange Program in 2023 as part of its efforts to strengthen government work.
Through this program, the Republic of Kazakhstan has collaborated with the United Arab Emirates across six different work streams, with the aim of developing advanced leadership capacities, modernizing government processes, and elevating digital transformation to new horizons.

Within the framework of cooperation between the United Arab Emirates and Turkmenistan on the government knowledge exchange program, His Excellency Muhammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs of the United Arab Emirates, and His Excellency Rashid Meredov, Deputy Prime Minister of Turkmenistan and Minister of Foreign Affairs, signed a memorandum of understanding between the governments of the United Arab Emirates and Turkmenistan on Exchanging experiences in the field of developing and modernizing governments, on the sidelines of the World Government Summit, held in Dubai from 13-15 February 2023.

As part of the government knowledge exchange program partnerships, the governments of the United Arab Emirates and Zimbabwe during the 10th edition of the World Government Summit, signed a bilateral cooperation agreement to exchange experiences in the field of developing government modernization, and improving governance and evaluation processes, and innovation programs, by benefiting from the experiences of the UAE in government work.

The United Arab Emirates and Romania, represented by His Excellency Abdulla Nasser Lootah, Deputy Minister of Cabinet Affairs for Competitiveness and Knowledge Exchange, and Minister Mircea Abrudean, Secretary General of the Government of Romania, signed a memorandum of understanding during the 10th edition of the World Government Summit. This agreement focuses on experience exchange cooperation in the field of government development and modernization, enhancing the efficiency of central public administration institutions through exchanging knowledge, experiences, and development models, and benefiting from the UAE's successful experience in government work.

The cooperation focuses on the workstreams of Digitalization and Digital Transformation in Government Services, Government Accelerators, Capacity Building, Sustainable Development Goals, Economy and Investment, Artificial Intelligence, Space, and Innovation.

His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates and Dr. Abiy Ahmed, Prime Minister of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia, witnessed the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to exchange experiences in the field of government development and modernization, aimed at strengthening cooperation between the two governments.

The agreement was signed by His Excellency Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs; and Her Excellency Alemtsehay Paulos, Minister of Cabinet Affairs of the Federal Democratic Republic of Ethiopia.

The partnership between the government of the UAE and the government of the Republic of Uganda, which focuses on exchanging experiences in the field of government development and modernization in a way that contributes to the development of government services, strengthening institutional capabilities and performance measurement systems in the government sector, and establishing an institutional framework to enhance and develop cooperation between the two countries and benefit from successful development models and exchange experiences. and successful practice.

  The partnership was signed by His Excellency Mohammed bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs and Chairman of the World Government Summit Foundation, and His Excellency General Odongo Jeji Abubakar, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Uganda as part of the activities of the World Government Summit 2024.

The governments of the United Arab Emirates and Côte d'Ivoire have launched a strategic partnership to exchange experience and expertise across 10 key areas in the fields of government work modernization and development. This new partnership adds to the UAE's government experience exchange initiatives with governments around the world, aimed at expanding the horizons of international cooperation to share future government experiences and practices.

The United Arab Emirates and the Republic of the Philippines have signed a memorandum of understanding aimed to strengthen government modernization and development. This partnership is based on the exchange of experience and expertise in various fields.

Ilham Aliyev, President of Azerbaijan, received Mohammad bin Abdullah Al Gergawi, Minister of Cabinet Affairs, who was heading the Emirati governmental delegation visiting the Azeri capital, Baku. 

During the meeting, the two sides signed a cooperation agreement aimed at exchanging expertise in areas of government modernization between the UAE and Azerbaijan.

 The bilateral cooperation agreement, promotes the exchange of government expertise, and focusses on eight pillars, which are government excellence, government services, government capacity building, competitiveness and statistics, policies and strategies, government performance, and government accelerators.

In February 2024, a bilateral cooperation agreement on government modernization was signed between the governments of the United Arab Emirates and Brunei Darussalam as part of government experience exchange partnerships

The governments of the United Arab Emirates and Kingdom of Eswatini signed a cooperation agreement to exchange expertise in government development and modernisation. This agreement is part of the UAE Government Experience Exchange Programme, which aims to transfer and share best practices with governments worldwide and expand partnerships with countries on the African continent.

H.E. Omar Sultan Al Olama, Minister of State for Artificial Intelligence, Digital Economy and Remote Work Applications, Director General of the Prime Minister’s Office; and Honourable  Savannah Maziya, Minister of Information, communication and Technology (ICT) signed the agreement.

The governments of the United Arab Emirates and Bermuda have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on experiences exchange in the development and modernisation of government models.

The agreement, signed at the United Nations (UN) High-Level Political Forum (HLPF) on Sustainable Development, builds on the close bilateral relations between the UAE and Bermuda and aims to help the two agile, future-oriented governments drive economic, environmental and social development.

Under the MoU, the UAE Ministry of Cabinet Affairs and Bermuda’s Ministry of Economy and Labour will create a framework for sharing information on initiatives for enhancing government services and policies. The framework will see the governments share best practises in human capacity building to help public sector employees gain critical skills in areas including technology and leadership.

Within the initiatives of the UAE Government Experience Exchange Programme GEEP, the governments of the UAE and the Republic of Kenya have launched a new partnership to exchange knowledge and share experiences in governance and governmental work development. The two parties signed a Memorandum of Understanding MoU in the presence of His Excellency Sheikh Shakhboot bin Nahyan Al Nahyan, Minister of State, during the fourth session of the UAE-Kenya joint Committee.

The MoU was signed by Her Excellency Maryam Bint Ahmed Al Hammadi, Minister of State and Secretary General of the UAE Cabinet, and His Excellency Musalia Mudavadi, Prime Cabinet Secretary and Cabinet Secretary for Foreign and Diaspora Affairs of Kenya.

As part of the United Arab Emirates’ efforts to strengthen international cooperation in government development, The UAE Government has signed strategic partnerships with the government of Andorra.
The signing aims to strengthen cooperation in several areas, including cybersecurity, data analysis, artificial intelligence, e-government, investment, and finance.
